# Review summary: branch `claude-review` (2026-10-10)

## Chosen LLM config (defaults in `backend/app/config.py`)
`gemini-3.5-flash-lite` for both calls, `reasoning_effort: low`, via Gemini's OpenAI-compatible endpoint
(`OPENAI_BASE_URL`), `LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=15`, `LLM_MAX_RETRIES=1`. Measured live: 2.8–3.8 s per analyze request,
0.76–2.27 s per LLM call. All measured runs are listed below.

## API contract changes
**None.** Endpoints, request bodies and response bodies are unchanged; `docs/openapi.json` regenerated byte-identical.
Two additive HTTP header changes only:
- 411 / 413 / 429 responses now carry the CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`), so the browser can read them.
- `Retry-After` was added to `Access-Control-Expose-Headers`, so frontend JS can read it on a 429.

## What changed (commits on `claude-review`, all pushed)
1. **Gemini via the OpenAI-compatible endpoint** (`3014fcd`)
   - New setting `OPENAI_BASE_URL` (default `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/`), passed as `base_url` to the OpenAI client.
   - Default `NORMALIZE_MODEL` / `EXPLAIN_MODEL` = `gemini-3.8-flash`.
   - Removed the unused Claude-only settings (`NORMALIZE_EFFORT`, `EXPLAIN_EFFORT`, `LLM_REFUSAL_FALLBACK`).
   - `app/llm.py` now maps every exception `parse()` can raise:
     - Truncated reply (`LengthFinishReasonError`) and schema/JSON errors: retried once, then `502 llm_invalid_output`.
     - Content filter: `422 input_refused`.
     - Timeout, connection, auth, rate-limit and 5xx errors: `503 llm_unavailable`.
     - Any other SDK error or unexpected exception: `502 llm_error`.
     - None of these produce a raw 500.
   - Calls `client.chat.completions.parse`, and `openai` is pinned to the tested `3.28.0`.
   - `tests/test_llm.py` rewritten for this SDK; the `httpx2` import is gone. Added tests for every new mapping, `base_url` and the Gemini defaults.
   - `README.md`, `.env.example`, `pytest.ini` and comments now describe Gemini.
2. **CORS fix** (`c3ef7f6`): `CORSMiddleware` is now registered last, so it is the outermost layer. Three new tests cover 429, 413 and 411.
3. **Test fix** (`8bed6f0`): `tests/test_check_data.py` runs the script by absolute path, so the suite passes from any working directory.
4. **Root `README.md`** (`571847f`): quick start for judges (install, demo mode without a key, live mode with a Gemini key, tests).
5. **Latency fix** (`e1ba264`)
   - New setting `LLM_REASONING_EFFORT`, sent as `reasoning_effort` on both calls. The default is `low`; `default` omits the parameter.
   - New measured defaults: `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, effort `low`, `LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=15` (was 60), `LLM_MAX_RETRIES=1` (was 2).
   - Measurements are below.
6. **Demo cache recorded from the live pipeline** (`22aec6a`)
   - All 15 entries are now `generated_by: pipeline`; there are no hand-written placeholders left. The recorder script itself is unchanged.
   - One input was replaced, with your approval: see the recording section.
   - `docs/examples/health.json` and `error_404_demo_no_match.json` regenerated. The other examples differed only in timing values and were left as they were.
7. **Live-test pacing and demo-input tables** (`f1b52a7`)
   - `tests/test_llm_live.py` spaces live calls 60/14 s apart to stay under the free-tier quota. No assertion changed.
   - Both READMEs list all 15 demo inputs with their demo result. A new offline test (`test_readmes_list_every_demo_input`) keeps the lists in sync with `data/demo_inputs.json`.

## First live smoke test, old defaults (gemini-3.8-flash, 60 s timeout, 2 SDK retries)
| Request | status | explanation_source | Structured output | Total time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text "plastic plates and cups" (en) | `complete` (plastic_tableware 6.2 MANUFACTURE, confidence 0.98) | **`fallback`** | normalize: **parsed**. explain: never returned (3 × 60 s timeouts) | 237.6 s |
| image (synthetic drawn tomato-paste can, no text) | `complete` (tomato_paste 3.9 DONT, confidence 0.99) | **`llm`** (grounding guard passed on the 1st attempt) | normalize and explain: **parsed** | 239.6 s |

The image was a Pillow drawing of a red can labelled "TOMATO PASTE", not a real photo.

Why it was slow: single Gemini calls took about 27 s to over 60 s. Calls over 60 s hit `LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=60`, and the SDK retried up to 2 times. That happened on 3 of the 4 calls.

## Latency comparison (measured; 12 live API calls in total)
Same two requests for every config, sent through the full `/api/analyze` stack (in-process):
- text: "plastic plates and cups", expected plastic_tableware
- image: the synthetic tomato-paste can, expected tomato_paste

Timeout 120 s, SDK retries off (so each request made at most 2 LLM calls), market preview off. Plus 1 `models.list()` call.

`models.list()` on this key returned 62 models. There is no text-only `gemini-3.8-flash-lite`. The newest text
Flash-Lite is `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`; also present: `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`, `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `gemini-flash-lite-latest`.

| Model | effort | Request | Total time | normalize / explain | status | explanation_source | Category correct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| gemini-3.8-flash | minimal | text | 0.8 s | failed at normalize | 502 `llm_error` | – | – |
| gemini-3.8-flash | minimal | image | 0.5 s | failed at normalize | 502 `llm_error` | – | – |
| gemini-3.8-flash | low | text | 55.9 s | 11.7 s / 44.2 s | complete | `llm` | yes |
| gemini-3.8-flash | low | image | 120.1 s | normalize > 120 s (timeout) | 503 `llm_unavailable` | – | – |
| **gemini-3.5-flash-lite** | **low** | text | **3.6 s** | 1.7 s / 1.9 s | complete | **`llm`** | **yes** (0.95) |
| **gemini-3.5-flash-lite** | **low** | image | **2.8 s** | 1.2 s / 1.5 s | complete | **`llm`** | **yes** (1.0) |
| gemini-3.5-flash-lite (new defaults, real uvicorn, nothing overridden) | low | text | 3.1 s wall | 1.2 s / 1.9 s | complete | `llm` | yes |

Notes:
- "minimal" failed immediately with `llm_error`; the exact HTTP status was not captured.
- "minimal" was not tried on Flash-Lite.
- Chosen default: **gemini-3.5-flash-lite + low**, the fastest config that gave `llm` and the right category on both requests.
- With a 15 s timeout and 1 retry, the worst case per request is bounded: recognition 2 × 15 s, plus up to 2 explanation calls (grounding retry) at 2 × 15 s each. A failed explanation falls back to the template.

## Live test suite (`pytest -m llm`, gemini-3.5-flash-lite / low), measured
**Final run, with pacing: 20 passed, 0 failed** (98.7 s, no HTTP 429). Both `test_live_explain_is_grounded[en]` and `[ar]` printed
`ungrounded: []`: every number in the English and Arabic explanations was found in the report.

First run, before pacing: **19 passed, 1 failed.**

Passed:
- `test_demo_inputs_match_real_categories`;
- all 15 `test_live_normalize_demo_inputs[...]`, including the new `plastic_chair_metal_legs_uncertain`;
- `test_live_unsupported`;
- `test_live_prompt_injection_is_ignored`;
- `test_live_explain_is_grounded[en]`.

Failed: `test_live_explain_is_grounded[ar]`.
- **Real cause: the API quota, not the model or our code.** Gemini returned HTTP 429 `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`: "Quota exceeded for metric `generate_content_free_tier_requests`, limit: 15, model: gemini-3.5-flash-lite" (quota id `GenerateRequestsPerMinutePerProjectPerModel-FreeTier`, retry delay 19 s).
- It was the suite's 19th call in about 19 s. The SDK's single retry, about 0.4 s later, was rejected too.
- Fix: the live tests are now paced to at most 14 calls per minute, with no assertion changed. The re-run with pacing passed 20/20 (above).
- No failure was caused by model behaviour, so no model limitation was added from this run.

## Known risks (most serious first)
1. **Flash-Lite latency was measured on 4 analyze requests (2.8–3.8 s) and 40 recorder calls (0.76–2.04 s each)**, all on 2026-10-10 between 04:00 and 04:20 JST. Gemini latency varied widely for gemini-3.8-flash (12 s to over 120 s per call), so Flash-Lite may vary too under load. If it does, the 15 s timeout turns a slow call into the template explanation (or a 503 at recognition) instead of a multi-minute wait.
2. **Flash-Lite classification was measured on 19 text inputs (15 recorder inputs, the replacement input, "plastic plates and cups" twice, 1 Arabic request) and 1 synthetic image.** It got 18 of 19 text inputs right, plus the image. The miss was the ambiguous "plastic folding chair" (→ `unsupported`). The 20 `-m llm` tests pass (with pacing). Still untested live: `/api/analyze/confirm`, the grounding *retry* path, `market_preview` (UN Comtrade), and a real camera photo.
3. **Rate limit (most likely to bite during judging):** the key is on the Gemini **free tier: 15 requests per minute per model**, as stated in the API's 429 error. In the recording run, 30 calls went through in about 45 s before 429s started, so the quota appears to allow short bursts; the exact behaviour was not measured.
   - Each analyze request makes 2 calls, so expect about **7 analyze requests per minute** before failures.
   - A 429 that survives the SDK's one retry becomes `503 llm_unavailable` at recognition, or a template explanation at the explain step.
   - The SDK's retry came about 0.4 s later, well before the 19 s retry delay the API asked for.
   - Mitigations: use `DEMO_MODE=true` for heavy demo traffic, or move the key to a paid tier.
4. Unhandled 500 responses still carry no CORS headers. Starlette's error middleware sits outside CORS; this was not changed.
5. The tests still read the developer's `backend/.env` through `load_settings()` (hermetic-test work was skipped by request). A `.env` that changes models, limits or the confidence threshold can change test results.
6. No lock file or CI. Direct dependencies are pinned, transitive ones are not. Tested only on Windows with Python 3.11.17.
7. `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` and `gemini-3.8-flash` both existed on this key on 2026-10-10 (`models.list()`).
8. Git commits used `zalhasani05 <zalhasani05@gmail.com>` as author through per-command `-c` flags. No git config was changed.
